title: This merge proposal will fix failing autopkgtests in APT as a consequence of dpkg inserting coreutils-from-uutils in Build-Depends on Ubuntu in dpkg-checkbuilddeps. The fix is to insert coreutils-from-uutils as an installed package in the dpkgcheckbuilddeps() wrapper.
description:
This merge proposal will fix failing autopkgtests in APT as a consequence of dpkg inserting coreutils-from-uutils in Build-Depends on Ubuntu in dpkg-checkbuilddeps. The fix is to insert coreutils-from-uutils as an installed package in the dpkgcheckbuilddeps() wrapper.

According to the changelog, APT does not have any historically recorded delta with Debian, however the change is a result of a Ubuntu specific change for dpkg. Thus it is considered unnecessary to upstream this change unless dpkg does so also.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 273ddc0..d378a0f 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+apt (3.3.3ubuntu1) tenacious; urgency=medium
+
+  * test/integration/framework: insert coreutils-from-uutils in the
+    dpkgcheckbuilddeps() wrapper as dpkg inserts it as a Build-Depends on
+    Ubuntu (LP: #2174193)
+
+ -- Simon Johnsson <simon.johnsson@canonical.com>  Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:40:06 +0200
+
 apt (3.3.3) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   This release introduces initial interactive help output for apt(8)
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index d7bb7b0..9206990 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -1,7 +1,8 @@
 Source: apt
 Section: admin
 Priority: required
-Maintainer: APT Development Team <deity@lists.debian.org>
+Maintainer: Ubuntu Developers <ubuntu-devel-discuss@lists.ubuntu.com>
+XSBC-Original-Maintainer: APT Development Team <deity@lists.debian.org>
 Uploaders: Michael Vogt <mvo@debian.org>,
            Julian Andres Klode <jak@debian.org>,
            David Kalnischkies <donkult@debian.org>
diff --git a/test/integration/framework b/test/integration/framework
index df50619..0e4c5cf 100644
--- a/test/integration/framework
+++ b/test/integration/framework
@@ -221,7 +221,14 @@ dpkg_version() {
 	command perl -MDpkg -E 'say $Dpkg::PROGVERSION'
 }
 dpkgcheckbuilddeps() {
-	command dpkg-checkbuilddeps --admindir="${TMPWORKINGDIRECTORY}/rootdir/var/lib/dpkg" "$@"
+	# Ubuntu requires coreutils-from-uutils to be installed on builds
+	if ! grep -q '^Package: coreutils-from-uutils$' \
+		"${TMPWORKINGDIRECTORY}/rootdir/var/lib/dpkg/status"; then
+		insertinstalledpackage 'coreutils-from-uutils' 'all' '1'
+	fi
+
+	command dpkg-checkbuilddeps \
+		--admindir="${TMPWORKINGDIRECTORY}/rootdir/var/lib/dpkg" "$@"
 }
 gdb() {
 	local CMD
